summary: Mapped domain objects, materials, three metaphors, environment and rhythm. Anti-default Ledger rejects four defaults of the dev-tool landing genre and keeps monospace as a domain convention rather than a borrowed style.

claims.claim: Three materially different creative territories are available: instrument panel, two-column diff, heartbeat trace.
The surface is glanced at from a second monitor, so the resting state must be legible in peripheral vision.

risks: The peripheral-vision claim is inferred from the usage environment and was not observed.
